design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER - task 0 (rent_ledger_and_delinquency, category lease). Updated at every step; revisions at the end.

[Step 0 - draw] `draw_counts.py <diff> --task 0` printed {"task": 0, "key": "env_0023_multifamily_apartment_reit/rent_ledger_and_delinquency/0", "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 4]}. `--tasks 2` also showed task 1 = 1 prerequisite problem, factor counts [6, 6]. Assignment: courtesy waiver (root) 5 factors, employer discount credit 5, catch-up payment 4.
[Step 0 - scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing (task 0 is first). Claimed here: lease_ext_employer_discount_credit (state_due credit), lease_ext_rent_catch_up_payment (the resident's own payment), lease_ext_courtesy_waiver_amount (on-request waiver) and their tools post_employer_discount_credit_34aaf7ea, make_rent_catch_up_payment_381e22a2, grant_courtesy_late_fee_waiver_1c994f24. Headroom left for task 1 (one prerequisite, [6, 6]): the late fee review / charge reversal (lease_charge_credit, charge_reversal) and the payment plan the resident signs (lease_payment_plan_requests) - neither is touched here, and task 1's tree (plan <- late fee review) is independent.
[Design thesis] Surface goal: 'waive my March late fees as a courtesy'. Scored core: the courtesy waiver amount (130.50). Chain the agent must discover: waiver waits on a catch-up payment for the period in the full catch-up amount (the waiver rule's prerequisite sentence), and the catch-up amount waits on the March base rent line carrying the preferred employer discount credit (the catch-up rule's prerequisite sentence), which the ledger shows missing. Depth 2 hops; breadth: 14 factors over the ledger, the late history, autopay history, tenure, three renewals (term), term length (term), parking + storage holdings and the utility payment history. The customer names none of the numbers.

[Problem-tree card]
root lease_ext_courtesy_waiver_amount (agent, grant_courtesy_late_fee_waiver_1c994f24)
  -> lease_ext_rent_catch_up_payment (USER, make_rent_catch_up_payment_381e22a2): kind value_input, gate last_pay, form state; prerequisite sentence (affirmative): 'A courtesy waiver on a billing period is granted only after the ledger shows a catch-up payment for that period, received on or after its first late day, in the full catch-up amount.' Four-point test: ordering connective 'only after'; XX = a record-visible state (a payment row on the ledger, dated on/after the first late day, in the catch-up amount); no tool/id/code token; strength 'only after', scope = that period. Exactly one write of this difficulty creates lease_payment rows (the catch-up payment tool; the plan tool of task 1 writes plan requests, not payments). Derivation: sentence + ledger (only 700.00 on 2026-03-12 since the 2026-03-08 first late day) + the catch-up rule ('A catch-up payment is the resident's own one-time lease payment that brings the most recent late billing period ... current') -> the catch-up payment. Seed evidence false at opening: lease_payments.<700 payment>.amount = 700.0 < 1172.34. Load-bearing: skipping it gives waiver 145.00 instead of 130.50 and no payment row.
     -> lease_ext_employer_discount_credit (agent, post_employer_discount_credit_34aaf7ea): kind value_input, gate rent_credits, form state; prerequisite sentence (negated direction, chosen because a payment desk says an amount 'is not fixed until' its credits stand): 'The catch-up amount for a late billing period is not fixed until that period's base rent line carries the preferred employer discount credit owed on a lease enrolled in the preferred employer program.' Four points hold (connective 'not ... until'; XX = a credit line on the base rent line; no code token; scope = that period, only for enrolled leases). Exactly one write creates preferred_employer_discount credits (this tool). Derivation: sentence + leases.rent_discount_program = preferred_employer + 2026-03 base rent line without a credit (every month 2025-02..2026-02 has one) + the employer discount rule ('A preferred employer discount credit is owed for every billing period ... whose base rent line carries no preferred_employer_discount credit') -> post the credit. Load-bearing: skipping it gives catch-up 1280.00 instead of 1172.34.
Topological order: employer credit (step 13) -> catch-up payment (step 15, user) -> waiver (step 17). A chain: no parallel pair. value_input edges: 2 >= max(2-1,1). The customer's own write: the catch-up payment (a payment is the resident's own act; the agent unlocks it at step 14 and hands it over). Both directions of prerequisite sentence are used in this charter.
Tools block nothing: each tool writes its arguments without reading the prerequisite state (see prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block). user_scenario mentions neither the discount nor paying first.

[Factor card - lease_ext_employer_discount_credit, 107.66; all-baseline 99.00]
- renewal_step (parameter, cross-difficulty term): ladder >=3 renewals +0.010 / 1-2 +0.005 / none 0. Evidence: 3 term_rent_changes renewal rows (2023-10-15, 2024-10-15, 2025-10-15). Baseline -> 92.81.
- autopay_step (parameter): >=10 ach_autopay drafts in 12 months +0.005 / 6-9 +0.0025 / else 0. Evidence: 11 drafts 2025-04-01..2026-02-01 (near-miss: 2025-03-02 was ach_one_time and 2025-02-11 too). Baseline -> 100.23.
- tenure_step (parameter): >=48 months +0.005 / 36-47 +0.0025 / else 0. Evidence: MONTHS(2022-10-15, 2026-03-22) = 41. Baseline -> 103.95.
- household_bundle_step (parameter, cross-difficulty parking, multi-source): parking AND storage +0.005 / parking without storage +0.0025 / else 0. Evidence: parking license 118 active + storage B1-S012 active. Baseline -> 100.23.
- late_period_share (method): late period with no other late period in 12 months -> 3/4 rounded down; with another -> 1/2 rounded half up; not late -> whole. Evidence: 2026-03-08 initial line; the 2025-02-05 line is 13 months back (near-miss excluded by the 12-month window). Baseline -> 143.55.
Rate = 0.05 + 0.010 + 0.005 + 0.0025 + 0.005 = 0.0725; 0.0725 x 1980.00 = 143.55; x 0.75 rounded down = 107.66. Past credits (5% of rent) are never re-rated, so no obligation is lit for earlier months.
[Factor card - lease_ext_rent_catch_up_payment, 1172.34; all-baseline 3446.34]
- application_order (method, cross-difficulty term): no return in 12 months AND >=1 renewal -> rent first / no return AND no renewal -> fees, rent, late fees / otherwise charter order (AZ: fees, late fees, rent). Evidence: 0 returns, 3 renewals. Baseline -> 1466.34 (700.00 = 99.00 fees + 195.00 late fees + 406.00 rent).
- recurring_fee_carry (parameter): >=10 autopay drafts none / 6-9 half / else all. Evidence 11 drafts. Baseline -> 1271.34.
- late_fee_carry (parameter): no other late period in 12 months none / exactly one: up to the initial line / else all. Evidence as above. Baseline -> 1367.34.
- next_month_window (method): >=36 months never / 12-35 three days / else ten days. Evidence 41 months; 2026-03-22 is exactly 10 days before 2026-04-01, so the baseline carries the 1980.00 April rent -> 3152.34.
Result: rent 1980.00 - credit 107.66 = 1872.34; 700.00 to rent -> 1172.34 still unpaid; no carries.
[Factor card - lease_ext_courtesy_waiver_amount, 130.50; all-baseline 195.00 (the base rule: every late fee line in full)]
- covered_lines (method): waived on record > 250.00 initial only / >0 initial + first five daily / nothing all lines. Evidence: 156.00 of 2025-02 waiver credits. Covered 95.00 + 5 x 10.00 = 145.00. Baseline -> 175.50.
- lateness_share (parameter): >20 days 0.60 / 11-20 0.80 / <=10 whole. Evidence: latest payment 2026-03-22 (the catch-up payment). Baseline -> 145.00.
- lateness_clock_start (method): returned draft in period -> return date / due date on Sat or Sun -> following Monday / else due date. Evidence: no ach_autopay return, 2026-03-01 is a Sunday -> 2026-03-02; 21 - 1 = 20 days. Baseline (21 days, share 0.60) -> 101.50.
- term_bonus (parameter, cross-difficulty term): >=13 months +0.10 / 10-12 +0.05 / else 0. Evidence: current term 12 months. Baseline -> 123.25.
- household_bonus (parameter, cross-difficulty utility, multi-source): >=12 utility payments in 12 months AND balance 0 +0.05 / >=12 AND a balance +0.02 / else 0. Evidence: 12 payments 2025-04-18..2026-03-18 (near-miss 2025-03-18 excluded), balance 0.00. Baseline -> 123.25.
Share = min(1, 0.80 + 0.05 + 0.05) = 0.90; 145.00 x 0.90 = 130.50.
Per task: multi-source factors = household_bundle_step, household_bonus, application_order's compound tests; cross-difficulty = renewal_step, household_bundle_step, application_order, term_bonus, household_bonus.

[Base-invariant card] Employer credit and waiver (subject lease_charge_credit, governing base policy lease_evt_credits_and_waivers): concession_term_length (lease_terms initial new_lease 12 months >= concession_min_term_months 12, evidence the new_lease term row); courtesy_tenure (time; anchor leases.move_in_date 2022-10-15 + 6 calendar months = 2023-04-15, inclusive, not_before; frozen 2026-03-22 satisfies it; 2023-04-14 would fail); waive_once (the 2026-03 base rent line and the 2026-03-08 initial line carry no credit before). Prose conditions of the courtesy waiver kept in force: waivers in 365 days = 0 (last waiver 2025-02-20), autopay enrolled (true; floor plan requires it), returned payments in 365 days = 0, not eviction_filed; 'late rent paid in full' is replaced (declared overwrite) by the catch-up-payment prerequisite sentence. Catch-up payment (subject lease_payment; governing lease_evt_payment_acceptance and lease_payment_plan): payment_acceptance_status (lease active); plan_signed (the only plan is the completed 2023 plan; the payment carries no plan reference). No time gate on payments.
[Overrides declared] employer credit replaces the base 'preferred_employer_discount_pct times the monthly_rent' clause with the stepped rate; catch-up payment replaces the base allocation clause with the standing-based application order; waiver replaces 'one credit per late fee line in full' and 'late rent paid in full'.
[Business-object card] Target: lease 1-207, billing period 2026-03. Key: billing_period + source_charge_id (the 2026-03 base rent line for the employer credit, the 2026-03-08 initial late fee line for the waiver). Rows entering the sums: the 2026-03 base rent, three recurring fee lines, eleven late fee lines, the 700.00 payment dated after 2026-02-22. Excluded: all earlier periods (each nets to zero; their credits are never re-rated), the 2025-02 late fees (already waived), the 2026-02-01 autopay (outside the one-month payment window).

[Seed] Customer + lease + 14 months of ledger (2025-02..2026-03: 14 base rent, 42 recurring fees, 13 employer credits, 17 late fee lines, 6 waiver credits = 92 lines; 14 payments), the completed 2023 plan request, 4 Lease Term Agreements with 3 renewal rent changes, a utility account with 13 usage bills and 13 payments, a parking license and a storage rental. Every row is load-bearing: the ledger rows are the period sums and the history counts; the Feb 2025 rows are the near-miss late period and the 156.00 waived on record; terms/rent changes feed three factors; utility rows the household bonus; parking/storage the bundle step. March 2026 late fees were posted exactly as the late fee review of task 1 allows for this lease (95.00 initial on 2026-03-08, ten 10.00 daily lines), so that state_due policy yields 0.00 here and lights no extra obligation. No automatic clause fires: the ten daily lines are the maximum, April rent is not yet posted, insurance is on file, no certified-funds restriction. balance_due 1574.00 matches the ledger (no cache trap is used).

[Persona] Lorena, embarrassed but warm; volunteers only the surface goal and the situation the seed supports (autopay paused for a bank switch, 700.00 paid 2026-03-12, autopay back on - leases.autopay_enrolled true). Identity only when asked (phone for lookup; DOB + SSN last four for verification; email only if asked). Authorization: credits/waivers yes; payments only when told the amount and handed the tool, once, by debit card. Passive reactions: surprise if told a missing credit was added, accepts a partial waiver, ends on 'waiver posted'. No ask beyond the waiver; never suggests an order or a number.

[Standard solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify(DOB, SSN4) -> read lease, charges, payments, terms, rent changes, parking, storage, utility account + bills, plan requests -> read the waiver rule: it waits on a catch-up payment -> read the catch-up rule: it waits on the March discount credit, which the ledger lacks -> post the employer credit 107.66 -> compute the catch-up 1172.34, unlock and hand the payment tool to the resident who pays by debit card -> compute the waiver on the updated ledger (latest payment 2026-03-22) 130.50 and post it.
[Verification run] scratch harness (check_compute's build_env/eval_compute + the real task tools, applied in order): B 107.66 (factor baselines 92.81 / 100.23 / 103.95 / 100.23 / 143.55; all 99.00); E after B 1172.34 (1466.34 / 1271.34 / 1367.34 / 3152.34; all 3446.34), E without B 1280.00; D after E 130.50 (175.50 / 145.00 / 101.50 / 123.25 / 123.25; all 195.00), D without E 145.00. Gates (--task 0): EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK (18 actions, det, non-vacuous, closure 145 = init 145); SOLVABILITY OK (3 calls, 8 base gates, 107 seed rows); COMPUTE OK (3 comps, 14 factors, 5 cross, 89 history rows, 66 branches); GROUNDING OK; CACHE-DIFF INFO; SCOPE OK.
[Draft recomputation from the visible context] Using only the published rules, tool schemas, finder returns and the persona: the waiver rule forces a catch-up payment first; the catch-up rule forces the discount credit first; the credit is 0.05+0.010+0.005+0.0025+0.005 on 1980.00 = 143.55, three quarters rounded down 107.66; the 700.00 goes to rent first -> 1172.34; the waiver covers 145.00 at share 0.90 -> 130.50. Agrees with gold; no second reading was found (the only fork a careful reader could doubt, the Sunday due date, is stated in the clock rule).
[Manual gates] Length/breadth: 2 hops, 14 factors, one user write that is genuinely the resident's (money leaves her account). Need expression: object (March late fees), authorisation (credits yes; payment by hand-over) explicit. Chronology: every volunteered fact is in the seed (700.00 on 2026-03-12; autopay true). Time anchors: tenure gate as above; lateness clock stated in the rule. Authority: plan status, discount state, waived amounts all from records. One frozen_time; no external event. Rule/compute equivalence checked sentence by sentence through compute_basis; every ladder stated in full in the rule. Baselines are the base charter's own treatment (5% discount; charter allocation with the next month's rent near the due date; waiver of every line in full).
[Revisions] (1) D2 first counted late_fee_waiver lines; the 2025-02 base-rule waiver is six lines, so a count mis-tiered the customer -> changed to the waived amount on record (156.00, threshold 250.00); harness re-run: 130.50. (2) task_tools.py first had module-level helper functions, which check_extended would read as undiscoverable tools -> inlined into each tool; tool gate re-run OK. (3) replay flagged plan_request_id '' as a dangling FK -> seed stores None for ordinary payments and the payment tool stores '' as None; replay re-run OK. (4) March 2026 late fees re-laid at the late fee review's allowed amounts so the task-1 state_due review yields 0.00 on this world.

[Revisions - rework round 2, answering audits/policy_task/rent_ledger_and_delinquency (0.md PASS; items bearing on this task)]
- O-1 / T0-O2 / T0-O3: the late fee review policy now states outright that late fee lines post on the late fee review schedule and that its grace days and first late day are the effective grace period and first late day every other rule reads; the March 2026 lines of this world (95.00 on 2026-03-08, ten 10.00 lines) are therefore posted on the charter's schedule, and the 2025-02 lines belong to an earlier period that 'is not reopened'. The closure's why_false now cites that schedule and notes that the base date 2026-03-05 would leave the state false too. No figure moved (review reversal on this world still 0.00).
- O-4 / T0-O4: the waiver rule now says the five daily lines are valued 'each at the average amount of the daily late fee lines posted for the period' (100.00 / 10 = 10.00), removing the floor-plan-rate reading (139.50); gold 130.50 unchanged; tracing reworded.
- O-6: the waiver rule now says that when the period's initial late fee line already carries a charge_reversal credit the waiver credit goes against the earliest daily line carrying none (waive_once); here the initial line carries no credit, so the argument is unchanged.
- O-2: the employer credit compute now returns 0 when the period's base rent line already carries a preferred_employer_discount credit ('A credit already posted for a billing period is never re-rated'); 0.00 before, 107.66 unchanged on the opening world.
- O-3: the catch-up rule now reads 'less the returned payments dated in that month', matching compute; O-3b: the lateness clock rule now reads 'when the latest ach_autopay payment return on the lease is dated within the period', matching compute. No return exists here; figures unchanged.
- F-3 (latent, CO): the catch-up application order's first tier is now 'rent first, then late fees, then recurring fees', distinct from the CO charter order (rent, recurring fees, late fees); on this world the 700.00 still goes wholly to rent, 1172.34 and every factor figure unchanged (to_fees for that tier now reads paid - to_rent - late_net).
- T0-O1: the verification call now passes exactly what the persona gives 'if they ask you to verify' (DOB 1988-06-22 + SSN4 1286, 2 matches); the phone number stays the locator only.
Re-run (final block, both tasks): EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK; SOLVABILITY OK; COMPUTE OK (A 107.66, B 1172.34, C 130.50, all factor and baseline figures unchanged); GROUNDING OK; SCOPE OK.
user_scenario:
You are Lorena Castillo, 37, a dental hygienist who has rented apartment 1-207, a one-bedroom-with-den home at Larkspur Scottsdale Quarter, since October 2022. It is Sunday afternoon, March 22, 2026, and you are calling the Resident Services Center a little embarrassed. In late February you switched banks and paused your autopay so it would not hit the old account; March rent sat unpaid while the new account was set up, you paid $700 on the portal with your debit card on March 12, and you have since turned autopay back on so it is ready for April. Now your ledger shows a string of late fees for March, and the one thing you are calling about is whether Larkspur can waive those March late fees as a courtesy - you have been a good resident for three and a half years and this was a one-off.
When the representative needs to find your account you give your mobile number, 480-551-0147. If they ask you to verify who you are, you give your date of birth, 1988-06-22, and the last four digits of your Social Security number, 1286; you give your email, lorena.castillo14@gmail.com, only if they ask for it specifically. You do not remember the exact March figures - the rent after any discount, how many late fees posted or what you still owe - and you tell the representative to go by what their records show; the only figure you remember is the $700 you paid on March 12.
You are happy for the representative to post any credit or waiver on your ledger for you without checking each one with you. Money leaving your account is different: you only pay something if the representative explains that it needs to be paid, tells you the amount and hands the payment over to you - then you make exactly one payment of that exact amount yourself, with your debit card, right then, and you read back the confirmation you get. If they ask how you want to pay, it is your debit card. If the representative mentions that a discount or credit was missing from March and has now been added, you are pleasantly surprised and say you had not noticed. If they say the waiver can only cover part of the late fees, you accept whatever they say they can do. You do not know how the waiver rules work, so you never suggest amounts, steps or what should happen first, and you never ask for anything beyond the March late fees. Once the representative tells you the waiver has been posted, you thank them warmly and end the call.
